export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/janak-industries) shows 67 records, 1 trading partner, 2 port lanes, latest cargo 2025-11-19. Exact rows seen (5 of 67 displayed): "2025-11-19 | JANAK INDUSTRIES | To Order | TURMERIC POWDER - OTHER DETAILS AS PER I | MUNDRA SEA, India -> St Petersburg Ex Le, RUSSIA | 09103030 | BOL 4152710"; "2025-09-03 | JANAK INDUSTRIES | TO ORDER | RED CHILLI POWDER TEJA | MUNDRA SEA -> ST PETERSBURG EX LE, Russia | 9042211 | BOL 9506498"; "2025-08-12 | DRY RED CHILLI WHOLE | MUNDRA SEA -> ST PETERSBURG | 9042110 | BOL 4249439"; "2025-06-04 | TURMERIC POWDER | INMUN1 -> St Petersburg | 09103030 | BOL 2442356"; "2025-05-16 | CHIA SEEDS | Mundra -> St Petersburg | 12079990 | BOL 9160776". Source counter: page header claims 67 shipments; only 5 rows actually rendered on the free view.
note: Export side is factually confirmed: five dated Mundra->St Petersburg (Russia) sea shipments between 2025-05-16 and 2025-11-19 with bill-of-lading numbers, covering turmeric powder, red chilli powder/whole and chia seeds. Declared HS 091099 (spice mixtures) does not match the observed codes: actual codes are 09103030 (turmeric), 09042110/09042211 (chilli) and 12079990 (chia seeds) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the code should be corrected to the observed range (turmeric/chilli/chia) and the verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. Note the buyer field is 'To Order' (order/negotiable B/L), so the end consignee is not public. Domestic supply evidence could not be verified: DuckDuckGo search backend was down (connection refused) for both queries, and volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, so no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record was retrieved — recorded as unknown, not as absent. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free views: null. No CIN/PAN found; not invented.
